notes: One reusable media+accordion section rendered twice: 'Most Kids Are Missing Key Nutrients' (7 items, CTA 'Shop Now') and 'Raising the Bar on Your Child's Nutrition' (6 items, CTA 'Start Today'). Easy to miss: the two instances differ in item count and CTA label but share the '45-Day Money Back Guarantee' line and #standalone-product-section anchor; each item has an icon badge in its summary. Behaviour: first item open on load in each instance, and details carry a per-section name attribute so only one item stays open at a time.

assertions.why: The rebuild replaces two original sections (accordion_block_driBft and accordion_block_QpghhN); both instances must render.
Original driBft section has exactly 7 accordion rows (Stress & Mood Swings through Picky Eating); scoping to the id also proves the original anchor id is preserved.
Original QpghhN section has exactly 6 accordion rows (Fights Hidden Hunger through Ingredients Sourcing and Dosage); scoping to the id also proves the anchor id is preserved.

Every one of the 13 original summaries carries an icon badge image (stress face, pencil, broccoli, microscope, checkmark badge, etc.); a missing icon URL renders nothing and a screenshot of closed rows can hide it.
Each original section pairs the accordion with a large product image (wheel-teens-multi-tdk and teens-multi-holding-tdk); both must be present.
first_open is configured true for both instances, so on load exactly one item per section (the first) must carry the open attribute — no more, no fewer.
Exclusive one-open-at-a-time behaviour relies on all 13 details sharing a per-section name attribute; if any item lacks it, multiple panels can stay open, which a static screenshot never shows.

assertions.contains: Most Kids Are Missing Key Nutrients. Get Help in Just 2 Gummies.
assertions.why: Full h2 of the first instance, assembled from the extraction's three fragments including the highlighted span text; the trailing '. Get Help in Just 2 Gummies.' is easy to drop.

assertions.contains: Raising the Bar on Your Child's Nutrition
assertions.why: Exact h2 copy of the second instance, including the apostrophe in Child's.

assertions.contains: With Vitamin B6 for mood regulation and Vitamin B12 for energy balance, these gummies help support emotional stability.*
assertions.why: Body of the first (open) item must be visible in rendered text on load, trailing disclaimer asterisk included — proves both the copy and the open state.
Summary titles are visible even when closed; the ® symbol is easy to lose to retyping or encoding.
The two instances have different CTA labels; the first must say 'Shop Now', exactly as extracted.
The second instance's CTA reads 'Start Today', not 'Shop Now' — a copy-paste of one instance would silently pass a body-level check.
Both originals show a guarantee line under the CTA; each instance must render its own.
Exact guarantee copy from the extraction, scoped to the section's own element so a match elsewhere on the page (e.g. buy box) cannot mask its absence here.
Wide heading, image column and pill CTA must not push the 390px viewport sideways; grid children need min-width 0 to avoid it.
